news.title: Telengana readies sweeping land pooling policy for infrastructure projects
news.para: The Telangana government plans to roll out a novel land pooling policy designed for infrastructure advancements throughout the state. Instead of receiving monetary compensation, landowners will be rewarded with developed plots when their land is acquired. Initiatives for projects like the Musi riverfront are already in progress, aiming to lower land acquisition expenses.

news.title: Notice to 500 homeowners in HSVP sectors in Gurugram for building code violations
news.para: Haryana Shehri Vikas Pradhikaran has launched a crackdown on homeowners misusing residential spaces for business purposes. Approximately 500 property owners have been notified for various breaches. With an increased focus on compliance, estate offices are conducting detailed surveys. Homeowners will have the chance to respond, yet failure to correct these violations may lead to disconnections of services or reclaiming of properties by the authorities.

news.title: FIR against Ghaziabad's RKS Buildcon India for handing over flats without CC
news.para: RKS Buildcon India stands accused of illegally transferring home possession without a requisite completion certificate, leading to the Ghaziabad Development Authority filing an FIR against the builder. This case opens the door for over 100 developers to face potential legal actions due to widespread non-compliance within the region. Even with regulations in place, a number of developers persist in unlawful deliveries, causing the GDA to initiate reporting for further action.

news.title: US Supreme Court won't hear Zillow's bid to escape investor class action
news.para: Recently, the US Supreme Court decided against hearing Zillow Group's appeal linked to a class action lawsuit, which alleges that the company provided misleading information to investors about its failed home-flipping endeavor. Investors contend that Zillow's overly optimistic statements resulted in significant financial damage when the division was shut down.

news.title: Runwal Enterprises shares make muted market debut; end nearly 2% lower
news.para: Runwal Enterprises Ltd experienced a tepid debut as its shares were listed on the market. Opening slightly above the issue price, the stock ended lower by day's close, fluctuating throughout the intraday session. With a notably oversubscribed IPO, investor interest was strong, and the funds raised will be allocated towards debt repayment and upcoming projects.

news.title: Mumbai court frames charges against builder, firm in ₹28-crore flat fraud case
news.para: In a significant development, a special MPID court in Mumbai has laid down charges against developer Vijay Machhindar and his spouse for allegedly defrauding homebuyers of Rs 28 crore by failing to deliver promised residential flats. The couple faces accusations of document forgery to obtain a loan from PNB Housing Finance Ltd.

news.title: Raymond Realty pre-sales rise 98% to ₹902 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Raymond Realty reported pre-sales of ₹902 crore in Q2 FY27, up 98% year-on-year, while collections increased 67% to ₹682 crore. For H1 FY27, pre-sales rose 111% to ₹1,602 crore and collections increased 57% to ₹1,233 crore.

news.title: South Bengaluru. Experience the finer way of living
news.para: Shriram Properties Ltd is making significant strides in Bengaluru’s southern corridor by developing residential projects that emphasize community living. With 52 projects already delivered and plans for 41 more, the area is witnessing a surge in residential demand. Enhanced connectivity via NICE Road, alongside a strong educational infrastructure, attracts families and professionals alike. Anticipated future developments, including a new airport, are poised to further elevate the region's appeal.

news.title: Odisha proposes inclusion of 28 more ULBs in PMAY 2.0
news.para: The Odisha government is set to enhance the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban by adding 28 more urban local bodies, aiming for comprehensive coverage across all 100 urban areas in the state. This initiative will facilitate housing assistance for numerous households, as executive officers are tasked with determining eligible beneficiaries and conducting groundwork for smooth implementation. Verification will focus on housing adequacy and income criteria for families in urban poverty.

news.title: Ambuja Neotia Group to restructure businesses for external funding; IPO a long-term possibility
news.para: Ambuja Neotia Group is consolidating and restructuring entities within the group to create a structure capable of receiving institutional capital, chairman Harshavardhan Neotia said. The exercise is expected to take six-nine months, while the group continues to invest around ₹2,000 crore annually and plans three project launches in the current financial year.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh will achieve 100% housing coverage for poor  by 2029: CM
news.para: Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu of Andhra Pradesh outlined a bold initiative to ensure complete housing availability for the impoverished by 2029. The government plans to construct three lakh houses under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin scheme, with support from the central authorities. Naidu took aim at the previous administration for poor handling of housing issues.

news.title: Gurugram: Residents of The Westerlies threaten legal action over deficiencies in amenities
news.para: Residents of The Westerlies demonstrated against Experion Developers for security and maintenance issues in their township. They raised concerns over damaged infrastructure, insufficient sewage systems, and increased maintenance charges. The Resident Welfare Association demanded a probe into alleged builder irregularities and proper audits of accounts. Residents also expressed dissatisfaction with incomplete amenities and inadequate facilities like parks and community clubs.

news.title: Patna civic body to hold property tax camps across wards
news.para: Starting October 5, Patna Municipal Corporation will host ward-specific property tax assessment camps. These sessions aim to evaluate unassessed holdings and rectify the tax records. Homeowners are encouraged to attend to clear any outstanding dues and avert potential penalties. This initiative is part of an extended door-to-door survey designed to boost revenue collection, with sanitation inspectors earmarking properties for assessment.

news.title: Rajasthan government notifies rural land conversion rules, moves approvals online
news.para: Starting November 2, 2026, Rajasthan is set to launch new regulations for the conversion of agricultural land to non-agricultural purposes. Applications can be submitted via a centralized online portal for efficiency. The fee structure varies: residential units will cost Rs 2,000, while other types will attract a Rs 20,000 fee.

news.title: Visakhapatnam civic body to streamline building permissions, water supply connections
news.para: In a recent meeting, GVMC's chief city planner A Prabhakar Rao assured developers that the town planning department is actively resolving building permission issues. This includes streamlining the application process for greater efficiency. Superintending engineer Pallam Raju addressed water supply connection procedures, while developers voiced concerns that officials responded to, elaborating on regulations and timelines for future projects. GVMC is committed to providing ongoing support to builders and developers.

news.title: New housing launches slow as developers in Goa turn cautious
news.para: In Panaji, the launch of new residential projects is stalled as developers grapple with escalating construction costs and uncertain regulations. Following a post-pandemic boom, the market is now experiencing reduced sales and growing unsold inventory. Local buyers are feeling the squeeze, with affordability declining despite stagnant prices. Some developers are opting to hold off on new ventures until clearer policies emerge, though a handful remain hopeful about future market dynamics.

news.title: Pune: Yerawada MHADA residents protest stalled redevelopment, demand mini-clusters
news.para: Residents of Yerawada are voicing dissatisfaction with the halted redevelopment project by MHADA, advocating for the creation of smaller housing clusters. They argue that the current mega-cluster proposal fails to ensure the necessary resident agreement, affecting over 3,500 homes. Their recent protest demonstrates a pressing need for faster solutions to unsafe living conditions.

news.title: Telangana clears registrations of non-NALA houses in 22-A relief move
news.para: The government of Telangana has announced a memo aimed at easing the registration process of homes built on converted residential lands. This initiative seeks to resolve the longstanding 22-A disputes that have hindered property owners. District collectors will be tasked with verifying applications to ensure compliance with the necessary NALA charges, ultimately providing relief for families previously unable to sell their homes due to these registration barriers.

news.title: Telangana government raises fire NOC height limit for apartments to 24 metres
news.para: The Telangana fire department is increasing the height limit for provisional Fire NOC regarding residential buildings. The new limit will be changed from 18m to 24m and will come into effect from October 7. This adjustment will simplify the approval process for lower and mid-rise apartments. However, safety measures such as emergency exits and firefighting systems will still be monitored during construction.
